_metadata.task_summary: Test patterns for /payroll/staging-comparison — bun:test, regression-style live DB tests (no mocks)

relevant_files.rationale: Existing tests for StagingComparisonService — uses bun:test, calls live service via getInstance() (no mocks), validates response shape (rows, summary, pct_match).
Test script: 'bun test'. Framework: bun:test (import { describe, it, expect } from 'bun:test').
Example of API-level test file naming convention (payroll.<feature>.test.ts in api/). Tests import the service directly — no supertest in this codebase.
Tests are regression-style: call method with default args, expect shape. No mocking of DB — assumes live DB connection.

patterns.mock_strategy: No mocking — tests assume live DB connection. Service singleton instantiated once at top of file.
patterns.http_testing: None observed for staging endpoints. Service is tested directly, not via HTTP. For new endpoint, no separate HTTP test needed unless explicitly requested.

integration_points.significance: Add new test case for the new method (e.g., monthlyStagingComparison or extend monthlyLoosefruit test). Use same pattern: getInstance().methodName(...), expect shape.
No existing test file for payroll.ts. Skip HTTP test unless required.

constraints: Live DB tests — no mocks for this codebase pattern
Test for new method: shape, types, and basic numerical sanity

clarification_needs.question: Test scope — add a single regression test for the new method, or also add HTTP-level test for the new route?
clarification_needs.context: Existing convention tests the service method directly. No HTTP tests exist for staging endpoints. User did not specify test requirements.
options: Service regression test only (matches existing pattern, fastest)
Service test + HTTP route test (full coverage, adds supertest-style harness)
